experiment: P3o-E invariant frozen-frequency delay parameter residual: two fresh-identity confirmation
hypothesis: The P3o-E delay residual produces repeatable twelve-parameter improvement without changing recognition logits, thresholds, or F backbone state, rather than exploiting the 1120M development identities.

confirmation_identities.identity_pairing: receiver_noise_seed paired across every regime and power view

frozen_evaluation: For each frozen seed, load its selected base and side checkpoints recorded in the passed 1120M development summary. Reconstruct the parameter normalizer and base threshold vector solely from the pre-existing 1110M training full-fit/calibration roles. Evaluate both models on each confirmation identity without training, selecting checkpoints, calibrating on confirmation data, or opening 1120M.
stopping_rule: Any gate failure permanently stops this residual variant. No checkpoint, loss, residual width/scale, data role, threshold, generator setting, or confirmation result may be tuned. Passing confirmation only promotes the mechanism to the subsequent preregistered five-seed/statistical and external-scope audit; it does not authorize any locked-test access.
